title: Car Rental Rate Classes: Branch, Border and Statutory Charge Scale
content:
Where the vehicle is collected, where it is returned and whether it leaves the country are priced by the class booked. The six Car Rental Rate Classes carry the following amounts, alongside the two statutory charges the class applies.

| Rate class | One-way fee (USD) | Cross-border permitted | Cross-border fee (USD) | Airport surcharge (percent) | Vehicle licence fee per day (USD) | Sales tax (percent) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Pay Now Saver Rate | 175.00 | no | 0.00 | 11.5 | 4.25 | 8.75 |
| Pay Now Standard Rate | 150.00 | no | 0.00 | 11.5 | 4.25 | 8.75 |
| Pay At Counter Flex Rate | 125.00 | yes | 89.00 | 11.5 | 4.25 | 8.75 |
| Inclusive Flex Rate | 95.00 | yes | 69.00 | 11.5 | 4.25 | 8.75 |
| Premium Inclusive Rate | 0.00 | yes | 0.00 | 11.5 | 4.25 | 8.75 |
| Corporate Negotiated Drive Rate | 85.00 | yes | 55.00 | 9 | 3.50 | 8.75 |

The one-way fee is the charge for returning the vehicle to a branch other than the collection branch. The cross-border columns record whether the vehicle may be taken across an international border and the charge for doing so. The airport surcharge is a percentage applied to the rental total when collection is at an airport branch. The vehicle licence fee is the vehicle licensing recovery fee charged per rental day, and the sales tax figure is the percentage applied to the rental total.

**Boundaries in the table.** The Pay Now Saver Rate and the Pay Now Standard Rate do not permit a border crossing, and their published cross-border fee is accordingly 0. Of the four classes that do permit it, the Premium Inclusive Rate carries no charge, and the other three carry 89, 69 and 55. The one-way fee falls from 175 on the Pay Now Saver Rate to 0 on the Premium Inclusive Rate. Sales tax stands at 8.75 percent on every class without exception; the airport surcharge stands at 11.5 percent on five classes and 9 percent on the Corporate Negotiated Drive Rate, which also carries the lower licensing recovery amount of 3.5 a day against 4.25 elsewhere.
